name: Dribble
doc: Dribble (Wendigo's enemy attack; the act family): one emitter per action - the grab sound, an actor system (its actor data the exe's) and the dribble: the target grabbed, morphed into a ball and bounced in the caster's hand, thrown, landing with dust, given back and walking back; the damage. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag041_dribble.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its state functions called from the phases, its parts spawned by it): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own - and the exe data words pointing into it (the engine's global index, the word)

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: The act family's master: once its children are gone, the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the dribble spawner, the dribble, the dust (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: the grab sound, the actor system (its actor data the exe's), the dribble spawner, the master's release, the damage

parts.title: Ball
parts.doc: The target grabbed, morphed into a ball, bounced in the caster's hand, thrown, landing with dust, walking back

groups.label: Sounds
groups.doc: The grab (at the emitter's sound tick), the landing

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: At the emitter's start: Start, Length (ticks), Mode

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The grab sound at this tick

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of its target from this tick

params.label: Grab ticks
params.doc: The morph starts at this tick of the dribble

params.label: Morph
params.doc: Into the ball a tick (4096: all of it)

params.label: Throw tick
params.doc: Bounced in the caster's hand until this tick, then thrown

params.label: Gravity
params.doc: Added to its falling speed a tick

params.label: Unmorph
params.doc: Back from the ball a tick in the flight (4096: all of it)

params.label: Dust
params.doc: The sprite sequence dust (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): the grab sound, the actor system and the dribble spawner, the master's release, the damage.
